erin: heads-up — ran a field profile on qwen-7b + mixed FP8/INT4 today and saw weird throughput cliffs when kv-prefetch is on. posting traces.
raj: :eyes: can you paste the perf run command and machine? want to repro.
erin: g4dn.12xlarge (single GPU). ran: `./run_profile --model qwen-7b --quant fp8+int4 --kv-prefetch=on --batcher=adaptive`
perf log chunk:
```
[profile] tokens/s: 1.2k (baseline int8: 2.6k)
[kv] kvcopy miss spikes at step ~1200
[kernel] selected fp8-conv fallback -> slow int-path
```
marta: hmm kv miss spikes look like cache thrash. sample-density for calibration? what sampling fraction used for quant calib?
erin: I used 2% random sampling across the dataset. calibration got skewed because many long prefixes in eval set.
liam: that explains it. long prefixes change per-token activation distribution -> int4/FP8 weight scaling diverges. try stratified sampling by prefix length.
jin: also check batching heuristic: adaptive batcher we use packs until latency SLO, but with kv-prefetch on it inflates sequence concat and triggers kernel selector to pick conv kernels that don't support fused kv-copy, causing extra memcpy.
raj: short note: kernel selector currently prefers fastest kernel by microbench for average seq len, but doesn't account for kvcopy path cost. we should add a penalty term when kvcopy path enabled.
perf-bot: benchmark run queued: bench/qwen-mix/2245678901/attempt-1 (ETA 12m)
marta: easy experiment: compare these three configs quickly:
- stratified calib sample + kv-prefetch on
- same + kv-prefetch off
- stratified + kv-prefetch on + kernel-penalty=0.25
for model set: qwen-7b, mistral-7b, llama-2-7b.
erin: results from qwen-7b (first 10m):
- stratified + kv-prefetch off -> 2.4k tokens/s, no regressions
- stratified + kv-prefetch on -> 1.9k tokens/s, kvcopy still a hotspot
- +kernel-penalty=0.25 -> 2.2k tokens/s, small latency tail improvement
liam: nice. so penalty helps nudge selector to kernels with fused-kvcopy support.
jin: on mistral we saw different behavior: fp8 kernels have better core throughput but calibration requires per-layer scale clamp; if you calibrate on too-short sequences fp8 saturates on long tails.
raj: action items:
- update calib recipe: stratified sampling by prefix/seq len and include 1–5% long tails. (assign: marta)
- add kernel selector penalty for kvcopy path (assign: raj)
- add small-prefetch-mode that limits in-flight KV pages to reduce mem-copies (assign: liam)
- share model-specific profile templates for qwen/mistral/llama (assign: erin)
marta: I'll drop a config snippet in this thread. sharing lightweight qwen profile (strings only):
```
quant_profile: "qwen-7b-mix-v1"
calib_sample: stratified
sample_buckets: ["<64","64-256","256-1024",">1024"]
sample_fraction_per_bucket: [0.4,0.35,0.2,0.05]
kv_prefetch: on
kernel_selector: {kvcopy_penalty: 0.25}
batcher: {mode: adaptive, max_inflight_kv_pages: 4}
```
erin: perfect. i'll run full sweep across the three models and post a summary. thanks team :pray:
liam: if we converge on these defaults we should add them to the shared model-profiles repo and tag as "safe-for-dedicated" for now.
jin: quick FYI — regression on an earlier run was due to a compiler change that swapped conv->gemm kernel mapping for fp8; another reason to keep explicit kernel penalties until selector learns new opt curves.
raj: agreed. i'll open a small PR to add the penalty flag and a metric in the console that shows kvcopy-memory-overhead per route.
erin: i'll attach traces and the full bench outputs when done. last: anyone seen quality hits from stratified sampling vs random? need to verify generation delta.
marta: we should run the eval harness on the post-calib weights. i'll queue it. :white_check_mark:
